title: BRABU UG 4th Merit List 2026
postName: UG CBCS (2026-2030) 4th Provisional Merit / Selected Student List
vacancyDetails: 4th provisional merit list for four-year UG CBCS programmes (BA, B.Sc, B.Com etc.) session 2026-30
qualification: 10+2 / Intermediate pass with subject eligibility for applied UG course
ageLimit: As per BRABU UG admission rules
applicationFee: Admission fee as per college / university
selectionProcess: Online Application → Provisional Merit Lists (1st to 4th) → Admission at allotted college
documentsRequired: Merit list print, 10th & 12th mark sheets, CLC/TC, migration, caste certificate, photo ID, passport photos
howToApply:
1. Visit https://brabu.ac.in
2. Open UG Admission / 4th Provisional Selected Student List
3. Download subject-wise PDFs (BA / B.Sc / B.Com)
4. If selected, report to college between notified dates (e.g. 21–25 Jul 2026)
5. Complete fee payment and document verification
shortDescription: BRABU has released UG CBCS 4th Provisional Merit List 2026-30 on 21 July 2026. Download subject-wise lists from brabu.ac.in and take admission as scheduled.
content:
Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (BRABU) has published the 4th Provisional Merit List for UG CBCS Session 2026–2030 on 21 July 2026.

Lists cover undergraduate programmes under Choice Based Credit System. Selected students must complete admission formalities at the concerned college within the university schedule.

Check notifications and PDFs under UG Admission on brabu.ac.in.
